Markup by Price Band

Give products a different markup% depending on their True Cost (item + shipping, converted above) — e.g. cheap items get a higher % to cover fixed costs. Leave a band's "max" blank to mean "and above". Rows outside every band keep the flat Markup % set above.

Title Cleanup

Many supplier exports (e.g. CJ Dropshipping) append a unique numeric code to each variant's title, which stops same-product rows from being grouped into one listing. Check this if your titles end in a number that isn't a meaningful part of the product name.

CJ Dropshipping exports combined variant names in one "Specification" column. Enable this to automatically split the "/" into Attribute 1 and Attribute 2.
